brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested a young man Saturday evening near Thabit Roundabout in the heart of Tulkarem city in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The detainee was apprehended in the roundabout area during an operation in the densely populated Palestinian city.

The circumstances surrounding the arrest remain unclear. No statement was immediately issued regarding the identity of the detained youth or the reasons cited by Israeli forces for taking him into custody. Arrests in Tulkarem have occurred with increasing frequency in recent operations across the West Bank.
